name: experience-capture
description: Convert natural-language human experience into the versioned experience-standard/v1 structure for any Agent.

interface.shortDescription: Structure natural-language experience for any Agent.
interface.longDescription: Provides a local HTTP API and browser lab that convert human experience into explicit and inferred structured items with evidence markers, boundaries, indexing hints, and knowledge gaps.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Experience Capture to structure a piece of human experience.
